questions.q: On Databricks, where do MLflow runs go by default when you train in a notebook?
options: A local folder on your laptop
Nowhere until you deploy an endpoint
The notebook's experiment on the Databricks-hosted tracking server
questions.explain: Databricks hosts an MLflow tracking server in your workspace; with no experiment set, notebook runs are logged to that notebook's experiment.

questions.q: Why are Optuna trials logged with mlflow.start_run(nested=True)?
options: Each trial becomes a child run under the tuning run, so they can be compared
It is required to use Spark
questions.explain: Nested runs group every trial under a parent tuning run, and each records its own parameters and metrics.

questions.q: What is the problem with tuning hyperparameters on the test set, as the quickstart does for brevity?
options: Test-set information leaks into model selection, so the final score is optimistic
questions.explain: Selecting the best trial by test score means the test set influenced the choice. Use a separate validation set or cross-validation, and touch the test set once.

questions.q: What is the format of a model name in Unity Catalog?
questions.explain: Unity Catalog names are three-level: <catalog>.<schema>.<model>, for example prod.ml_team.churn_model.

questions.q: How does Unity Catalog express which version is deployed, since it has no stages?
options: Aliases such as Champion that point to a model version
By renaming the model each time
questions.explain: Aliases are mutable named references to versions. Jobs load models:/<name>@Champion, and promotion is just re-pointing the alias.
